answer: Charge every new agent a refundable stake that scales with the delta between its claimed reputation and its verified history: a fresh identity starts near zero and earns trust only through attested work. Add a sable test - a randomized time-locked proof-of-work puzzle whose difficulty rises with each identity created from the same device fingerprint. Finally, color each attested transaction with a saffron tag, a non-transferable credential that accumulates only after sustained honesty, so a sybil farmer must pay real compute and time for every fake identity instead of cloning free ones.
